params.name: asObjectName
params.description: list below is the object name (string) of a form representation of the list.

params.name: asReference
params.description: If passed, itemsArray/the function result use fixed item references instead of current (expanded/collapsed-dependent) item positions.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the position or reference of the selected item(s) in the list identified by its object name (form representation).

discriminatedBy.rule: This overload applies when the leading * is passed, meaning list is an object name (Text) rather than a ListRef (Integer).

params.name: asReference
params.description: If passed, itemsArray/the function result use fixed item references instead of current (expanded/collapsed-dependent) item positions.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the position or reference of the selected item(s) in the list identified by its hierarchical list reference number (ListRef).

discriminatedBy.rule: This overload applies when the leading * is omitted, meaning list is a ListRef (Integer) rather than an object name (Text).

constraints: The mechanical draft left itemsArray with direction 'in', but the doc's arrow column marks it '<-' (out): the command writes the selected item positions/references into it.

If you use multiple representations of the same list and work with item positions (asReference omitted), only the object-name syntax (leading * passed) is valid, since each representation can have its own expanded/collapsed configuration.
